children.name: Subtitle
children.content: Daily aggregates from self-reported, anonymous reports. Every figure is approximate: installs choose to report, and nothing is verified beyond the report signature.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Version, server count and template count from every report, basic or extended.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Accepted reports per UTC day, last 30 days, ending today (in progress)

children.name: Sub
children.content: Reports in range by reported version. Top 10, then Other and Invalid.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Installs that also share the extended tier. Each install counts once per day; shares are weighted by install-days in the range.

children.name: Coverage label
children.content: Coverage: 71% of reports in range include extended data

children.name: Sub
children.content: First accepted report from an install ID

children.name: Sub
children.content: Installs whose last report was 30 days earlier. Today's bar is final after the UTC day closes.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days reporting each minor version across their managed clusters. Installs with several report each, so shares can add up to more than 100%.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days reporting each detected distribution across their managed clusters. Installs with several report each, so shares can add up to more than 100%.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days reporting each node architecture. Mixed clusters report several, so shares add up to more than 100%.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days by node-count band.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days by how the panel runs: on a cluster, or standalone. Other is installs on an older version that doesn't report it.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days running at least one server of each official module. Uploaded and third-party modules count as Custom.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Share of install-days with each feature in use.

children.name: Sub
children.content: Installs by their last reported version, over the last 30 days (the shorter of the range and the activity-record expiry).

children.name: Sub
children.content: Installs per day that upgraded, downgraded, changed between versions that can't be ordered, or stayed behind the newest version seen in the range (v0.3.0). Extended reports only.

children.name: Note
children.content: Behind v0.3.0, on its own scale

children.name: Note
children.content: All figures are approximate and self-reported. Reports are anonymous; extended reports are signed by a key the install derives locally, which stops impersonation but not invented installs.

children.name: Note
children.content: Install IDs are stored only as keyed hashes. Activity records expire 90 days after an install's last report, and daily aggregates are kept for 24 months. No IP address or raw report is stored.
